# dsh-xhs-note
Format a Xiaohongshu note (title max 20 Unicode code points) as a DeepSeek Harness tool. Do not pip
ongshu note (title max 20 Unicode code points) as a DeepSeek Harness tool. Do not pip the wrong dsh.
GitHub topic: dsh-plugin. Chinese: README.zh.md
## Try without dsh
node demo.mjs
Prints the sample title and the course URL.
## Install into a profile
This package is plain JavaScript. There is no prepare or build step, so a git install does not need
is plain JavaScript. There is no prepare or build step, so a git install does not need allowBuilds.
dsh plugin --profile web add github:guobinmengxiang-rgb/dsh-xhs-note
Check the composed layer without booting:
dsh --profile web --dump-config
You should see a dsh-xhs-note layer. Then start the profile as usual.
Official CLI is @deepseek-ai/dsh (today 0.1.0-rc.6). The PyPI package deepseek-harness-cli is a diff
erent tool (dsh doctor / dsh chat).
## Honest limits
- npx may not load local overlays. The course overlay in dsh-getting-started still needs an absolute

path to a TypeScript file.
- This bundle cordis.patch.yml uses the package name dsh-xhs-note, not a

filesystem path.
- DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview: THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CH

ANGES.
- The plugin runs on your machine.
## Tool

- Plugin export name: format-xhs-note
- Tool name: format_xhs_note
- Inject: tools
- Title rule: Uni

code code points, max 20
